name: Mu'izz-uddin Husayn ibn Ghiyath-uddin

name: Ghiyas-uddin Pir 'Ali
note: Timurid vassal after Timur took Herat (April 1381); article: executed with his family around 1383; table ends with Timur's conquest

name: Malik Muhammad ibn Mu'izz-uddin
note: co-ruler with Ghiyas-uddin Pir 'Ali, holding Sarakhs and part of Quhistan; article: remaining Karts murdered 1396 by Miran Shah
